dateProvenance: The flight CSV records GNSS HHMMSS only. Its calendar date was discarded by the firmware; 2026-07-28 is an archive-date assumption, not GNSS-derived.

firmwareNaming.bootDirectory: B######## is scv.boot_count; it changes on each OBC boot.
firmwareNaming.batchDirectory: D#### is floor(session/32) for LOGS and floor(frame_count/32) for CORAL.
firmwareNaming.csv: LOG_######_START_##########.CSV: session and HAL tick (seconds) at file open; files rotate every 60 seconds.
firmwareNaming.raw: F########_cloud#.RAW: Coral-supplied sequence and truncated cloud fraction percent; each valid RAW frame is 224×224 grayscale bytes (50,176 bytes).
